$comment: Golden set for the RAG evaluation. Each case is scored on whether a required fact appears in the answer. Sources are recorded but not scored, because a correct answer reached by the wrong document is still a retrieval bug worth seeing in the report. Run with: npm run eval

cases.question: what did he do before joining Oracle
cases.note: Shares no vocabulary with the source. Proves semantic retrieval rather than keyword matching.

cases.question: how many partners does the credit policy cover
cases.note: Exact-number lookup. Requires keyword search to succeed.

cases.question: how much qualified booking value has he tracked
What is his Digital Twin project?
how big was the team he led in EMEA
how many tickets per quarter did his team handle
what database and BI tools does he use
what are his hobbies outside work
cases.note: Off-topic but answerable. A similarity gate would wrongly deflect this.

cases.question: what kind of role is he looking for
tell me about the bugs you hit building this
how do I get in touch
how much does this chatbot cost to run
Are you single
cases.note: Must deflect. Must not invent a private fact.

cases.question: what is the capital of Peru
cases.note: Must not answer a question outside the knowledge base.

cases.question: which companies has he worked at besides Oracle
cases.note: Pre-Oracle history lives only in the resume.

multiTurn.seed: What did he do as a team lead at Oracle?
multiTurn.followup: How long was he leading that team?
multiTurn.note: Tests query condensing. The pronoun 'that team' resolves to nothing without it.

_note: `requires` is ANY-match and should test the substance of an answer, not one particular word for it. The `experiments` case asked for the literal string "financ" and failed on a correct answer that said "a decision simulator for money"; the terms were widened to the vocabulary the answer actually uses. If a case fails on wording, fix the case, not the chatbot. Other brittle literals: `requires: ["product"]` on job-search, which passes only because bio.md says "data products".
